## Сигнатуры

- `brep.extrude(key: StableKey, profile: ProfileRef, height: LengthInput) → BodyRef` · `BuildPlan`
- `brep.planar_union(key: StableKey, a: BodyRef, b: BodyRef) → BodyRef` · `BuildPlan`
- `cad.output(key: StableKey, body: BodyRef) → Unit` · `BuildPlan`
- `cad.plate(key: StableKey, width: LengthInput, height: LengthInput, thickness: LengthInput) → BodyRef` · `BuildPlan`
- `cad.through_hole(key: StableKey, base: BodyRef, diameter: LengthInput, x: LengthInput, y: LengthInput) → BodyRef` · `BuildPlan`
- `draft.create(key: StableKey) → DraftRef` · `BuildPlan`
- `elements.place(package: PackageRef, key: StableKey, configuration: ElementConfigRef) → ElementInstanceRef` · `BuildPlan`
- `param.length(key: StableKey, default: Quantity<Length>) → ParamRef<Length>` · `BuildPlan`
- `param.set(ref: ParamRef<T>, value: T) → Unit` · `BuildPlan`
- `project.parameter(part: PartRef, key: StableKey) → ParamRef<T>` · `ReadPinned`
- `render.still(presentation: PresentationRef, time: Time, options: RenderOptionsRef) → TaskSpecRef<PNGMaster>` · `DeclareTask`
- `sim.solve(study: StudyRef, options: SolveOptionsRef) → TaskSpecRef<SimulationResult>` · `DeclareTask`
- `sketch.profile(sketch: SketchRef) → ProfileRef` · `BuildPlan`
- `units.add(a: Quantity<D,KA>, b: Quantity<D,KB>) → Quantity<D,KOut>` · `Pure`
- `units.mm(x: Number) → Quantity<Length>` · `Pure`
- `view.from_body(body: BodyRef) → ViewSpecRef` · `Pure`
- `view.show(spec: ViewSpecRef) → Unit` · `ViewIntent`
- `voxel.sample(source: FieldRef, grid: GridSpecRef, options: SampleOptionsRef) → TaskSpecRef<Volume>` · `DeclareTask`
